**Thai in Tirol**

Discover the vibrant flavors of Thailand in the heart of the Alps! Whether you're craving a spicy **Green Curry** or a refreshing **Som Tum**, **Thai in Tirol** brings authentic Thai cuisine to **Innsbruck**, **Kufstein**, and beyond.

From bustling street food stalls to cozy restaurants, our menu features all-time favorites like **Pad Thai**, **Tom Yum Goong**, and the ever-popular **Kaiserschmarrn**—but with a Thai twist. Indulge in aromatic **Massaman Curry**, crispy **Satay**, and fragrant **Jasmine Rice**, all made with the freshest ingredients.

Experience the perfect blend of Alpine charm and Thai passion—**Thai in Tirol** awaits you! 🌶️⛰️
